conf.description: apache-httpd access dataset, syslog-raw format (Common/Combined Log Format text): parsing is deferred entirely to the Elastic apache integration's stock grok (Common, Combined, and TLS-annotated variants), which also populates apache.access.* alongside ECS fields. This pipeline is intentionally thin: it only tags event.dataset and passes _raw through untouched.

conf.comment: apache-httpd / access / syslog-raw: mod_log_config Combined/Common Log Format lines shipped as plain text (Elastic Agent file tail, or raw syslog where httpd pipes to logger). Do NOT re-grok %h/%l/%u/%t/%r/... here -- the Elastic apache integration ships its own grok for Common, Combined, and a TLS-annotated variant and populates apache.access.* plus ECS url/http/user_agent fields from _raw. Re-implementing that grok in Cribl would fight the integration and produce duplicate or conflicting fields.

functions.description: document why this pipeline does not parse _raw
tag the event with its dataset ahead of the Elastic integration's own parsing of _raw
